name: NOBA Bank Group AB
summary: Established in 2003 and headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden, NOBA Bank Group AB (publ) offers diverse financial and banking solutions. The group caters to retail customers across eight European nations, specifically Sweden, Norway, Finland, Denmark, Germany, Spain, Ireland, and the Netherlands. Its comprehensive suite of services includes personal loans, credit cards, specialized and equity release mortgages, international lending, and deposit accounts. NOBA operates under three distinct brands: Nordax Bank, Bank Norwegian, and Svensk Hypotekspension. The company was previously known as Nordax Bank AB (publ) before adopting its present name in June 2023.
